title: Burnham promises more devolution and public control of essential services
description: Tory leader Kemi Badenoch said Burnham was offering "more government control, more taxes and more politicians", as he addressed MPs for the first time as PM.

title: UK long-term borrowing costs highest since 1998 ahead of October Budget
description: Higher borrowing costs have piled fresh pressure on Andy Burnham ahead of his first Budget.

title: Keir Starmer announces he is standing down as MP
description: The move will trigger a by-election to replace the former prime minister in his London constituency.

title: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
description: A drone carrying an explosive device was discovered at the airport close to Ukrainian cargo planes on 4 August.

title: US strikes Iran as state media reports four killed at wedding party
description: Iranian news agencies said retaliatory missile and drone attacks on US targets had begun.

title: Ariana Grande ends tour and steps back from public life
description: The star makes an emotional farewell as she wraps up a tour she's described as her "last hurrah".

title: Baby girl who died at Sheffield house was stabbed, police say
description: A baby girl who was pronounced dead at a property in Sheffield was stabbed, police confirm.

title: Flood chased me as I ran for 20 minutes, Nepal tunnel worker tells BBC
description: Major efforts to rescue hydropower workers continue as Nepal's death toll exceeds 1,000.

title: Israel warns it will retaliate if UK imposes sanctions
description: The UK's Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband pledged on Tuesday to introduce a "comprehensive reset" of policy on Israel.
